name: Schlage Encode (US)

radios.note: Allegion says the Encode (BE489) has Bluetooth and Wi-Fi for pairing with the Schlage Home app. Wi-Fi is 2.4 GHz.

matter.note: No Schlage or Allegion page found says either way for the non-Plus Encode. Allegion says the Encode Plus does not support Matter; that article does not cover this model.

apple_home.note: Schlage and Allegion point Apple Home and Home Key users to the Encode Plus (BE499). A search snippet of Allegion's knowledge base says the BE489 has no HomeKit support, but we could not open the exact article, so this stays unknown.

google_home.note: Through the Schlage Home app and Google Assistant. Schlage says Encode products need no hub or adapter.

alexa.note: Alexa skill via the Schlage Home app.

smartthings.note: Schlage's pages seen list Alexa and Google but not SmartThings. Absence from the list is not a statement that it will not work.

home_assistant.note: Official Schlage integration; the docs list the Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt as tested. It uses Schlage's cloud API.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi; Schlage says no extra hub or accessory is needed for remote control.

localControl.note: Home Assistant control goes through Schlage's cloud; no source states what works with the internet down.

lockFit.note: Complete smart deadbolt with 5-pin C keyway, sold with Camelot, Century or Greenwich trim.

keypad.note: Touchscreen keypad on the lock; up to 100 access codes.

power.note: Four AA alkaline batteries included; Schlage estimates up to six months in typical use.

summary: The Schlage Encode is a US smart deadbolt with a touchscreen keypad and built-in 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, so no hub is needed. It works with Alexa and Google Assistant through the Schlage Home app, and Home Assistant has an official integration. It is the non-Plus model: Schlage points Apple Home and Home Key users to the Encode Plus. Four AA batteries are included.
caveats: Apple Home is not confirmed for this model; Schlage's Apple Home Key lock is the Encode Plus.
Matter and SmartThings support are not confirmed.
The Home Assistant integration goes through Schlage's cloud.
